title: How To Skip The Kimi K3 Waitlist
description:
Here's how to access the secret AI model everyone is trying to get their hands on 👀

Kimi K3 is apparently so powerful that they had to pause new subscriptions because of the massive surge in demand. But you don’t have to sit on the waitlist with everyone else. 

Here's a backdoor workaround to access the single-agent version of Kimi K3 right now:

1️⃣ Go to platform.kimi.ai (their developer platform) and create an account.
2️⃣ Head to the billing section and add a small credit (even $1 works).
3️⃣ Open the AI Playground and select "Kimi K3" from the model selector.
4️⃣ Adjust your settings: Crank the context window up toward the 1-million-token limit and increase the reasoning effort.
5️⃣ Start prompting directly in the Playground like a regular chatbot.

That's it. You're now using one of the most capable models available while everyone else is stuck in line. 

📌 Save this reel so you can refer back to the steps, and share it with someone who needs this workaround before it gets patched (or banned by the government...)
